note: A/B pass: Bob Kagle led Benchmark's $6.7M SERIES A into eBay in 1997 for roughly 22% — the single best-performing venture investment in Silicon Valley history, worth about $5B by spring 1999.
A/B pass: Matt Cohler led Benchmark's $11M FIRST-ROUND financing of Quora in March 2010 at an $86M valuation, joining the board — a Series A.

A/B pass: Equinix's entry round is not cited. Benchmark published no announcement archive and stopped listing companies in 2013, so a $1B+ row whose round predates or postdates the searchable press is carried as explicit citation debt rather than given a manufactured citation (COLLECTION.md §7). The stage itself stands on the firm's own listing year plus the round record; only the citation is missing.
